external_source_pins.finding: Agenttop binds /v1/metrics, /v1/logs and /v1/traces on 127.0.0.1:4318; metrics/logs are parsed, while traces are currently accepted without parsing/storage. Its parser supports protobuf first and JSON fallback and stores all log attributes.
OTLP/HTTP permits both binary Protobuf and JSON-encoded Protobuf and defines /v1/traces, /v1/metrics and /v1/logs.

hypothesis_update.supported: A thin F2-native normalization/fence layer can preserve explicit upstream provenance while refusing synthetic F2 causal closure and minimizing sensitive content at very small in-process JSON-fixture cost.
hypothesis_update.counterhypothesis_supported: A zero-dependency JSON-only implementation is insufficient for standards-complete OTLP/HTTP ingestion; full compatibility needs a pinned Protobuf path or a deliberate JSON-only transport contract that must not be mislabeled as general OTLP.
